key_concepts: Seafloor spreading occurs at divergent plate boundaries
Molten material rising from the mantle forms new seafloor
Old seafloor is recycled through subduction and melting
Earth does not expand despite seafloor spreading
Convection currents in the mantle cause plate movement
Ridge push and slab pull are mechanisms that move plates
Wegener's continental drift theory lacked a mechanism
Harry Hess proposed seafloor spreading theory in 1960
Plate tectonic theory states Earth's crust is divided into moving plates
Lithosphere is rigid and brittle while asthenosphere is viscous fluid
Subduction of a plate's leading edge can form volcanic arcs
Divergent boundaries can create new oceanic lithosphere
